# ResortPass Europa-Park

> Independent multilingual information service for Europa-Park ResortPass availability, current attraction wait times and day-by-day crowd forecasts.

## Canonical pages

- German: https://www.resortpass-europapark.ch/
- German wait times: https://www.resortpass-europapark.ch/wartezeiten/
- German crowd forecast: https://www.resortpass-europapark.ch/besucherprognose/
- French: https://www.resortpass-europapark.ch/fr/
- French wait times: https://www.resortpass-europapark.ch/fr/wartezeiten/
- French crowd forecast: https://www.resortpass-europapark.ch/fr/affluence/
- Italian: https://www.resortpass-europapark.ch/it/
- Italian wait times: https://www.resortpass-europapark.ch/it/wartezeiten/
- Italian crowd forecast: https://www.resortpass-europapark.ch/it/affluenza/
- English: https://www.resortpass-europapark.ch/en/
- English wait times: https://www.resortpass-europapark.ch/en/wartezeiten/
- English crowd forecast: https://www.resortpass-europapark.ch/en/crowd-calendar/

## ResortPass update feeds

- German: https://www.resortpass-europapark.ch/api/feed.xml?lang=de
- French: https://www.resortpass-europapark.ch/api/feed.xml?lang=fr
- Italian: https://www.resortpass-europapark.ch/api/feed.xml?lang=it
- English: https://www.resortpass-europapark.ch/api/feed.xml?lang=en

## Methodology and sources

- ResortPass availability is checked regularly and summarized from recorded observations.
- Attraction wait times are supplied by ParkQueueTimes.com and cached for about five minutes.
- Crowd-index forecasts and opening hours are supplied by ParkQueueTimes.com; the site does not claim an exact visitor count or guaranteed wait time.
- The canonical web pages are the intended representation of wait-time data; the feeds contain written ResortPass availability updates, not raw attraction data.
- Timestamps and source notes on each page explain freshness and limitations. Official Europa-Park channels remain authoritative.

This is an independent service and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by Europa-Park.
